answer: Each applicant locks a 70-credit bond in the grove registry and sends one fable token along a ripple path of grove nodes. Each node forwards at most one token per epoch and signs hops; the ripple ledger records hops. Auditors replay it; a gap or reuse burns the bond. The k-th identity pays 20+5(k-1) credits, as detours lengthen around exhausted nodes; the 1,000th pays 5,015. 1,000 fakes cost 70,000 locked plus 2,517,500 in fees, no reuse. A rented-forwarder ring fails at the one-token cap, extra signatures rejected. An honest agent pays one 70 bond and one 20 fee, bond back after one epoch.
